title: SDG 11 Urban Service Coverage Guidance
content: Districts with persistent drainage complaints should prioritize ward-level stormwater rehabilitation, with phased capex tied to demand density and deprivation indicators.

title: JJM Capital Outlay Norm Reference
content: When funding water supply projects, policy teams should compare per-beneficiary relative cost against scheme norms and prioritize high demand velocity clusters where investment gap remains large.

title: Aspirational District Priority Framework
content: Equity-weighted planning should boost interventions in aspirational districts and tribal blocks where deprivation remains high despite prior capital deployments.

title: PMGSY Maintenance and Access Guidance
content: Road asset planning should align hotspot demand signals with existing outlay commitments to identify districts where access gaps continue despite prior spending.
